paragraphs: The GLE400d is a relatively recent addition to the GLE-Class lineup, introduced with the V167 generation in 2019. It uses the OM656 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel with mild-hybrid assistance, a unit that represents a significant departure from the older OM642 V6 diesel that powered earlier generations of the GLE. The OM656 is a more modern, more efficient engine, and while it shares the '400d' badge with other models in the Mercedes range, its specific application in the GLE is a key point of fitment for any engine work.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLE400D on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLE400D from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLE400d uses a single, modern engine code (OM656) across its V167 generation, compatibility is more straightforward than on some older models that had mid-cycle changes.
